name: Object Sorting Robot Skills
description: Atomic robot skills for sorting objects. The decision engine composes these into pick-and-place sequences. The robot must always move to Home between positions.

skills.name: Move to Home
skills.description: Move to the safe Home position via /api/move/named {name: Home}

skills.name: Move to White Ball Pick Position
skills.description: Move to Pick_White_Ball position via /api/move/named {name: Pick_White_Ball}

skills.name: Move to Rainbow Ball Pick Position
skills.description: Move to Pick_Rainbow_Ball position via /api/move/named {name: Pick_Rainbow_Ball}

skills.name: Move to Orange Ball Pick Position
skills.description: Move to Pick_Orange_Ball position via /api/move/named {name: Pick_Orange_Ball}

skills.name: Move to Punch Pick Position
skills.description: Move to Pick_Punch position via /api/move/named {name: Pick_Punch}

skills.name: Move to Tape Pick Position
skills.description: Move to Pick_Tape position via /api/move/named {name: Pick_Tape}

skills.name: Move to Basket Drop Position
skills.description: Move to Drop_Position_Basket position via /api/move/named {name: Drop_Position_Basket}

skills.name: Open Gripper
skills.description: Open the Robotiq gripper via /api/gripper {action: open}

skills.name: Close Gripper
skills.description: Close the Robotiq gripper via /api/gripper {action: close}

skills.name: Stop Program
skills.description: Emergency stop — halt the current program

skills.name: Wait
skills.description: Wait for a specified duration or until the human signals readiness
